patterns.name: Next: six-count motion
patterns.description: Keep six even strokes, gently stressing 1 and 4. The recorded arpeggio is a later exercise.

cases.note: 6/8 practice suggestion: these six counts are eighth notes; one bar has two dotted-quarter beats. The recorded guitar uses arpeggios.
